item.title: Retired K-9 Roam's online shop sells out in hours
item.description: (COLORADO SPRINGS) — A new website launched to support retired Colorado Springs police K-9 Roam sold out of all merchandise within hours of its Friday, Feb. 20 opening. The website is hosted on Shopify at k9-roam.myshopify.com and is managed by Roam's owners to help fund the dog's continued medical care and support other working animals. [...]
